name: Rushabh Mehta
description: Rushabh Mehta is the founder and CEO of Frappe, the company behind Frappe Framework and ERPNext, which he began building in 2005 for his family business. After a failed first startup, he rebooted in 2008 and has been building ever since. He also founded the school Learners Collective. A lifelong Mumbaikar and avid fiction reader, he loves debating philosophy, history and economics.
